name: Universal TV Simplify Page
description: Strips complex multi-column layouts into a single readable column for TV

params.css: aside, [role='complementary'], .sidebar, [class*='sidebar'], [class*='Sidebar'], [class*='rail'], [class*='Rail'] { display: none !important; } main, [role='main'], article, .content, [class*='content'], [class*='Content'] { width: 100% !important; max-width: 1000px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; float: none !important; } .row, [class*='row'], [class*='col-'] { display: block !important; width: 100% !important; float: none !important; } body { overflow-x: hidden !important; }
